text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — campaign goes live next Tue 9:00 AM PT. Need X + LinkedIn posts, an X thread, and a 60s promo clip. Assets available: hero.png, benchmark-chart.png, speaker-headshots.zip. Who can draft copy and slot into the scheduler?
Liam O'Connor: I can draft the copy. Can someone confirm we want 1 long X thread (5 tweets) + single-image X post + LI post with link?
Sophia Chen: Yep — that's the plan. LI should be the longer-form narrative tied to the benchmark blog. X thread = teaser -> stat -> CTA -> speaker highlight -> signup.
Devon Rivera: I'll handle the assets (alt text + resizing). Which dimensions do we need? I can output 1200x675 for LI, 1200x675 for X single, and 1080x1080 for the thread images?
Maya Patel: Perfect. Also add a short animated GIF (15s) from the clip for X. Make sure hero.png has logo removed for the X single image variant.
Liam O'Connor: Draft 1 of copy incoming in ~45m. Quick ask: UTM params — use utm_source=x_social for X, utm_source=linkedin for LI. Campaign name = orbit_launch_v1. So final links like: https://redwood.com/benchmark?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=orbit_launch_v1
Sophia Chen: For the LI post, include the benchmark PDF link and tag the speakers: @Devon Rivera (if you want me to tag on LI I need their LinkedIn handles). Also include the webinar signup link: https://redwood.com/webinar/orbit-launch (use ?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=orbit_launch_v1)
Devon Rivera: I'll add alt text. For accessibility: hero.png -> "Graph showing latency vs cost improvements for Redwood Inference"; benchmark-chart.png -> "Line chart comparing token cost across model variants".
Liam O'Connor: Copy draft here — please pull verbs/phrasing: 
```
Tweet 1: :rocket: We just dropped a new benchmark showing 3x lower per-token cost on common LLM workloads. Thread below.
Tweet 2: Example stat, short sentence, link to blog.
Tweet 3: Quote from lead engineer about batching + quantization.
Tweet 4: Webinar CTA — join our live demo + Q&A. Register: https://redwood.com/webinar/orbit-launch?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=orbit_launch_v1
Tweet 5: Speakers + ask to RT + link to benchmark PDF.
```
Sophia Chen: Nice. Two tone variants: one punchy/technical (for X) and one polished/explanatory (for LI). I'll edit for LI length.
Maya Patel: Scheduling windows: post X main at 9:00 AM PT and thread at 9:02 AM PT. LI at 9:05 AM PT. We want to catch both US mornings and EU afternoon. Devon, can you confirm all assets are in the drive by EOD Mon?
Devon Rivera: Will do — uploading now to: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/orbit-assets (hero_v2.png, chart_v3.png, clip_60s.mp4, clip_gif.gif).
SocialBot: Reminder — Please add posts to the shared scheduler. Link to queue: https://scheduler.redwood.ai/queue/98765
Liam O'Connor: Who's monitoring replies for the first 2 hours? We should have someone triage leads and surface interesting questions to the sales queue.
Sophia Chen: I can monitor X for the first hour. Maya can you set up a Loom or short response templates for common Qs?
Maya Patel: I'll write 3 canned replies: registration link, pricing questions, deep-dive/tech-call request. Posting templates now: 
- Registration: "Thanks! You can register here: https://redwood.com/webinar/orbit-launch?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=orbit_launch_v1"
- Pricing: "Happy to connect — can I route you to our sales team? quick form: https://redwood.com/sales-contact"
- Tech call request: "We run weekly office hours — share your availability and we'll set up a deep-dive."
Devon Rivera: Also request from growth: run a small paid boost on the top-performing X post for 24hr. Who approves budget?
Maya Patel: Approve up to $500 for paid amplification. Growth to set targeting US + UK tech/ML audiences.
Liam O'Connor: One last thing — can we pin the benchmark PDF and webinar link in the first thread tweet so it's easy to find? Otherwise replies will ask for it.
Sophia Chen: Good call. I'll include the PDF link in Tweet 1 as a short link.
Maya Patel: Cool. Next steps: Liam finalizes copy + posts to scheduler, Devon uploads assets + alt text, Sophia edits LI + monitors initial replies, Maya prepares canned replies and budget sign-off. Check-in before EOD Mon. :thumbsup:
Liam O'Connor: On it. Will drop copy in #marketing-drafts for final sign-off.
SocialBot: Scheduled: none yet — awaiting user to push to queue. Use `SCHEDULER_CLI schedule --queue 98765 --post <post_id>` to queue.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — we're on track. Will do a quick rehearsal of the webinar slides Tue 11:00 AM PT.
Devon Rivera: Uploaded assets and noted alt text. Ping me if any tweaks. :eyes:
